correctness.rationale: Fresh independent code built the 21 Fano-incidence edges, exhaustively enumerated 457 nonempty faces, and computed binary boundary ranks d1..d6 = (13,57,97,44,12,2), yielding mod-two Betti vector (1,0,0,6,0,0,0). Rational Betti numbers are bounded by mod-two Betti numbers; Euler χ=-5 then forces rational H3 dimension 6 and all other reduced rational homology zero. Direct oriented simplex trace counting for r^k gives Lefschetz numbers (-5,2,2,2,2,2,2); the two invariant 7-vertex simplices each have +1 permutation sign. Hopf trace L=tr(H0)-tr(H3) gives H3 character (6,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1). The characteristic vector uniquely identifies augmentation ideal Q(ζ7), as the nontrivial irreducible rational C7 summand. This finite exhaustive calculation covers the actual fixed 14-vertex complex; it does not assert a graph-family theorem.
residual_risks: The new checker uses finite exact F2 linear algebra and direct signed-chain counts; it is not formal proof in Lean or an expert attestation.
The result covers only rational homology for one fixed graph and subgroup; integral C7 lattice and full automorphism-group invariants remain outside its claimed scope.
